notes.title: Major Update !
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] New scenarios;
[*] New enemies;
[*] More bosses;
[*] Challenge rooms;
[*] Curse and Blessing room;
[*] More power-ups;
[*] New chests;
[/list]

[h2]Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Code optimization: Smoother gameplay 
[*] Randomized rooms: Every playthrough is unique, with completely random rooms and enemies.
[*] Special rooms with obstacles: Overcome challenges to earn big prizes.
[*] Variable floors: The number of floors to reach the boss can change, adding unpredictability.
[*] Camera zoom: Zoom in or out for better exploration or navigation.
[*] Unlimited power-ups: Collect as many as you want, with no limit of 5.
[*] Improved luck system: Luck now affects more elements, such as chest types, special room appearances, enemy count, orb drop chances in chests, and more.
[*] Enhanced pause menu: Access the settings menu during gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stylized rooms: Every room now features distinct designs and color palettes.
[*] Overhauled interface: Easier to navigate and more intuitive.
[*] Improved lighting: The game is now brighter, with enriched light points that enhance the atmosphere.
[/list]

Best regards,
Sunfish🐠

notes.title: Official Game Launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, P. Wendler here!✌

I’m thrilled to announce the official launch of my game, set for [b]December 2, 2024[/b]! After a lot of hard work and dedication, I’m excited to finally share this experience with you, filled with new content and enhancements.

[h2]Here’s what you can expect at launch:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]10 Playable Characters[/b]: Each with unique abilities, adding variety and new strategies to explore.
[*] [b]60 Power-Ups Added[/b]: Boost your gameplay with a wide range of options that make the game even more dynamic.
[*] [b]3 Challenging Bosses[/b]: Put your skills to the test with bosses featuring unique mechanics and tough challenges.
[*] [b]5 New Enemies[/b]: Adding more variety and difficulty to each level.
[*] [b]Improved Settings System[/b]: Quickly and easily adjust preferences for a more personalized experience.
[*] [b]Camera Movement Enhancements[/b]: Experience smoother and more responsive camera movement for greater immersion.
[*] [b]Controller Support[/b]: Play with a controller and dive into a new way to enjoy the game.
[/list]

And this is just the beginning! I’ll be releasing free updates in the future to expand the content even further and keep improving the game.

Mark your calendars: [b]December 2, 2024[/b]! Thank you so much to everyone who has supported the development so far. I can’t wait for you all to experience this adventure. See you at the launch!

Stay tuned for more updates on the game soon!🎉

Best regards,
[b]Sunfish[/b]🐠

notes.title: Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Hello everyone, P. Wendler here!✌

I'm excited to announce that our game is on track for release this year! I'm thrilled to share that I managed to implement something I thought would be impossible: [b]full controller support[/b]. The game was developed using an [b]Xbox controller[/b], but it should work just as well with a [b]PlayStation controller[/b]. Below are the button configurations for each mode.

[h2]Gameplay Button Configuration[/h2]
[list]
[*] Left Analog Stick: Moves the player
[*] A: Use/equip item
[*] Y: Discard item
[*] RB: Shoot
[*] RT: Dash
[*] D-pad Left/Right: Select item
[*] D-pad Down: Open inventory
[/list]
[h3]Menu Button Configuration[/h3]
[list]
[*] D-pad Up/Down: Navigate menu
[*] D-pad Left/Right: Change settings
[*] B: Return to the previous menu
[*] Start: Pause the game
[/list]

For an enhanced gaming experience, using the controller activates auto-aim, which means the aiming cursor will not be visible when the controller is in use.

Stay tuned for more updates on the game soon!🎉

Best regards,
[b]Sunfish[/b]🐠
